subject: Quick question about my ticket
text:
Hi Dr. Ellis,

Just following up on the ticket I bought for next week's book talk. I think I accidentally picked the wrong calendar day because I misread the entry as starting the 12th instead of the 14th. Is there any way to switch it to the earlier evening, or do you need me to start over? I still have the confirmation receipt handy. I really enjoyed your lecture last month, too. Sorry for the mix-up, and thanks for being so easy to reach.

Warmly,
Tori
